title: nautilus component sidecar
description: `{Name}.component.json`, next to a mimic component: per-component metadata the component's own .svelte can't carry — its pipe connection points for the P&ID (`ports`) and the sample props the component preview renders it with (`preview`). Written by the component preview pane (the editor-title preview button on the .svelte or on this file) and read by the mimic editor; hand-editable, diffable. Any other key passes through the pane's edits untouched, reserved for future per-component metadata.

ports.description: Where pipes connect, as fractions of the rendered box (0,0 top-left to 1,1 bottom-right). For a kit built-in (Tank, Pump, …) this overrides the kit's defaults for the whole project; absent = the kit's defaults, or none for a custom component.

name.description: How a pipe end anchors to this port by name (a *.mimic.json pipe's from/to). Unique within the list.

dir.description: The direction a pipe LEAVES this port. Absent = inferred from the nearest edge.

preview.description: What the component preview pane renders the component with.

props.description: Sample prop values by prop name — any JSON value, passed to the component as-is.
